card.name: Fl- at the start of flare
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "flare" (Fl, fl, FL) right after a disease or condition name, as in hepatitis flare, gout flares, ALT flares. It also fires on some unrelated verbs and commas in general prose.

modes.label: Flare after a condition
modes.description: The beginning of "flare(s)" following a disease or lab term in drug labels.
modes.example: 5.2 Gout<< Fl>>ares After initiation of febuxost

modes.label: Other Fl- starts
modes.description: The start of a word like "Flawless" or "FLUSH" in instructions or web text.
modes.example: This is the first USB computer, marvelous in its design.<< Fl>>awless! If you like this page

modes.label: Stray general-prose words
modes.description: Weaker hits on verbs like was/were or a comma in history and news text.
modes.example: Germany’s capacity to restock its desperate army<< was>> broken.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word "flag" and away from odd symbol and code tokens, so the output effect is mostly a Fl- word-start cue.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word "flare", as in a hepatitis or gout flare.
